spans.s: See निर्-मज् under निर्-√ मज्ज्, p. 556, col. 1.
= مجموع دار majmū'-dār , a record-keeper, document-holder, Kṣitīś.
N. of a man g. सिवादि.
patr. fr. मजिरक, g. शिवादि.
1. मज्ज mfn. sinking, diving (in उद-मज्ज; see औदमज्जि).
2. मज्ज in comp. for मज्जन्.
id., ŚBr.; MaitrUp.; Hariv. (cf. निर्मज्ज).
मज्ज—कृत् n. ‘producing marrow’, a bone, L.
मज्ज—तस् ind. = मज्जाम् प्रति, Lāṭy.
मज्ज—रस m. = मज्जा-र्˚, L.
मज्जा—रस m. ‘marrow-secretion’, semen virile, L.
मज्ज—समुद्भव m. ‘produced from the marrow’, semen virile, L.
See अ-मज्जक.

(lit. ‘sunk or seated within’) the marrow of bones (also applied to the pith of plants), RV. &c. &c. (according to ŚBr. &c. one of the 5 elements or essential ingredients of the body ; in the later medical system that element which is produced from the bones and itself produces semen, Suśr.); scurf, Kull. on Mn. v, 135.

etym.s: [cf. Zd. mazga; Slav. mozgǔ; Germ. marg, marag, Mark; Angl.Sax. mearg; Eng. marrow.]

spans.s: मज्जन्—व॑त् mfn. marrowy (opp. to अ-मज्जक), TS.
N. of a demon causing sickness or fever, Hariv.
of one of Śiva's attendants, L.
sinking (esp. under water), diving, immersion, bathing, ablution, GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c.
(with निरये), sinking into hell, MBh.
drowning, overwhelming, ib.
= मज्जन्, marrow, L.
See मज्जल.
मज्जन—गत mfn. plunged in a bath, MBh.
मज्जन—मण्डप m. a bathing-house, bath, Siṃhās.
du. ‘Majjana and Unmajjana’, N. of two demons, Hariv.
one who causes to sink or plunge, ŚBr.
N. of one of Skanda's attendants, MBh. (v.l. मज्जान; cf. मज्जन).
the blue roller, L.
= मज्जन्, marrow, Suśr.
मज्जा—कर n. ‘producing marrow’, a bone, L.
मज्जा—ज m. a species of bdellium, L.
मज्जा˚टीका (˚ज्जाट्˚?) f. a partic. weight, Hcat.
मज्जा—मेह m. N. of a partic. disease of the urinary organs, ŚārṅgS.
मज्जा—रजस् n. a partic. hell, L.
bdellium, L.
मज्जा—सार n. ‘having marrow as its chief ingredient’, a nutmeg, L.
the female of the Indian crane, W.
N. of a man, Rājat.
repeatedly diving (used to explain मण्डूक), Nir. ix, 5.
a kind of grass, L. (v.l. गर्जर).
= मञ्जूषा.
greatness, majesty, RV.; AV.
(आ), ind. altogether, generally, at all (with न॑किस्, ‘no one at all’), RV.
See खर-मज्र॑.
माजल—पुर n. N. of a city, Cat.
pl. N. of a people, VP.
N. of a place, Cat. (v.l. माजुज and माजूज).
